# hue_room (Resource)

Manage a Hue room. Deleting this resource deletes the group from the bridge.

## Example Usage

```terraform
data "hue_device" "desk" {
  id = "22222222-2222-4222-8222-222222222222"
}

resource "hue_room" "study" {
  name      = "Study"
  archetype = "office"
  children  = [data.hue_device.desk.id]
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Required

- `children` (Set of String) Set of device UUIDs.
- `name` (String) Group name.

### Optional

- `archetype` (String) Hue group archetype. Defaults to other.

### Read-Only

- `id` (String) Bridge resource UUID.

## Import

Import is supported using the following syntax:

The [`terraform import` command](https://developer.hashicorp.com/terraform/cli/commands/import) can be used, for example:

```shell
terraform import hue_room.study 55555555-5555-4555-8555-555555555555
```
